title: Zesty Juicy Slovakian Mushroom Skewers
description: A pungent and juicy Slovakian dish featuring allspice berries, this recipe is perfect for adventurous eaters, and is jain-friendly as it contains no animal products. The combination of mushrooms, allspice, and lemon juice creates a unique flavor profile.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the allspice berries to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated mushrooms onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each mushroom.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with additional olive oil if necessary to prevent drying out.
Remove the skewers from the grill and serve hot.
Garnish with additional allspice berries and lemon wedges if desired.
